visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a rapid montage of dashcam and news footage illustrating traffic hazards in Taiwan. A white sedan stops abruptly for a child crossing a street at night, and news graphics show a woman and child narrowly avoiding a collision with a yellow and black bus in broad daylight. Other shots show crowded urban streets with numerous motorbikes and pedestrians. (2) A young woman with black hair in pigtails, wearing a white crochet-style top over a yellow shirt and light blue shorts, appears in a bright studio setting. She waves cheerfully at the camera and then puts on a bright yellow cap featuring a triangular safety logo. She performs specific hand gestures, including a 'stop' palm and crossing her arms to form an 'X'. (3) The scene transitions to the woman standing outdoors in front of a FamilyMart convenience store with green and blue signage. She holds up two cardboard signs with illustrations and text regarding road safety rules while smiling. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a small yellow 'SAFE' cap keychain being held by fingers to demonstrate its scale and detail. The background is a blurred domestic setting. (5) The final sequence shows the woman on a stage wearing a bright orange ruffled performance outfit with a white belt and a cartoon character cross-body bag. She waves her arms enthusiastically and speaks into a microphone, with the backs of children's heads visible in the foreground as they watch the performance.
